actions.action: Bind approvals to exact paragraph revisions
actions.mechanism: Approval records identify both source and translation revisions, preventing approval transfer after either text changes.
actions.implementation: Store immutable paragraph revisions and approval tuples containing language, stable IDs, both revision IDs, reviewer, and timestamp. Preserve superseded approvals as history.
actions.check: Substantively edit an approved source paragraph; confirm its new revision has no approval while an unchanged paragraph retains its approval.
actions.risk: Matching approvals by stable ID alone defeats revision protection.

actions.action: Separate paragraph movement from text modification
actions.mechanism: Ordering changes independently of paragraph text, while contextual moves receive targeted review rather than automatic approval reuse.
actions.implementation: Store order separately from content revisions. Compare stable IDs to identify moves; flag moved paragraphs and changed neighbor boundaries for context review.
actions.check: Move an unchanged paragraph: its text revision stays fixed, context review opens, and unrelated unchanged paragraphs remain approved.
actions.risk: A move can alter meaning without changing any words.

actions.mechanism: Explicit dependencies extend review to translations affected indirectly by changed definitions, references, or shared terminology.
actions.implementation: Let reviewers link dependent paragraph IDs. When a linked source revision changes, open review tasks for dependents and block their publication pending clearance.
actions.check: Change a defined term; verify its linked uses enter review while an unrelated paragraph does not.
actions.risk: Missing dependency links leave indirect effects undetected.

actions.action: Offer a focused human reapproval view
actions.mechanism: Reviewers compare source changes against the existing translation, deciding whether correction or explicit reapproval is needed.
actions.implementation: Display old and new source text, their diff, translation, and relevant context. Allow translation edits or unchanged-text reapproval bound to the new source revision.
actions.check: Use a punctuation edit and a substantive edit; verify neither becomes approved without a recorded human decision.
actions.risk: Small visual changes can carry substantial meaning.

actions.action: Divide affected work between two reviewers
actions.mechanism: A shared per-language queue assigns affected paragraphs without restarting completed work or routinely duplicating volunteer effort.
actions.implementation: Assign each task to one of the two reviewers; reserve the other for flagged uncertainty. Include dependency reasons, revision targets, and resumable progress.
actions.check: Create changes across six languages; verify each affected task has an owner and unaffected paragraphs generate no tasks.
actions.risk: Disputed paragraphs may remain blocked when both reviewers disagree.

actions.action: Reject approval of a superseded review target
actions.mechanism: An optimistic concurrency check detects source or translation changes made while a reviewer is reading.
actions.implementation: Capture both revision IDs when review opens. At submission, compare them with the task’s current targets; on mismatch, show intervening changes and require reconfirmation.
actions.check: Open review, change the source, then submit; verify the new revision receives no approval from that submission.
actions.risk: Frequent edits can repeatedly interrupt volunteer reviews.

actions.action: Gate publication on an immutable revision manifest
actions.mechanism: A release contains only explicitly approved source–translation pairs and cleared contextual review requirements.
actions.implementation: Freeze a manifest of paragraph IDs, order, source revisions, and six-language translation revisions. Validate approvals and outstanding review blocks before atomically publishing that manifest.
actions.check: Try publishing a cleared move, unchanged paragraph, and unapproved substantive edit; only the substantive edit must block release.
actions.risk: A live-data renderer could bypass the validated manifest.
